title: Tea punch
steps: Squeeze about 1 orange for the freshly squeezed orange juice and about half a lime for the freshly squeezed lime juice. Slice that orange and lime for garnish.
Mix the unsweetened iced tea, freshly squeezed orange juice, freshly squeezed lime juice, pomegranate juice, freshly pressed apple cider, and simple syrup, if using, in a pitcher or punch bowl.
Top with the orange, lime, rosemary, and pomegranate seeds.
